🆕 New (Published: September 8, 2026)

Saitama Prefecture is expected to experience very unstable atmospheric conditions through the late evening of September 9 due to a frontal system and warm, moist air flowing toward it.

Be alert and prepared for flooding in low-lying areas, swollen rivers, and mudslides.

Linearly organized rainbands may develop across Saitama from the early evening of September 8 through the early morning of September 9, with the risk of disaster potentially increasing sharply.

Check the Japan Meteorological Agency (JMA) website for Kikizuku (risk level maps) and time-series forecasts, and stay informed of the latest disaster prevention weather information.
